graph.frontierOrdering: ascending raw state key at each depth

primaryEndpoints: exact cumulative reachable raw-state count through minimum BFS depth 8
exact graph transition-occurrence count from parent depths 0 through 7
exact game-tree node-occurrence count through path depth 8
exact game-tree edge-occurrence count through path depth 8
secondaryEndpoints: exact raw-state count by minimum BFS depth 0 through 8
exact tree node occurrences by depth 0 through 8
exact duplicate/transposition encounter count within the frozen graph expansion
exact in-degree distribution summary and multi-parent-state count
exact arithmetic mean legal move-variant branching among nonterminal graph parent states at depths 0 through 7
exact geometric mean positive branching among those states
exact capture-forced versus non-capture-choice proportions under engine legality semantics
phase counts and terminal/nonterminal counts within the frozen reachable-state domain
computational wall-clock, CPU, peak RSS, frontier, and artifact-size measurements

stoppingRule.rule: first applicable resource cap stops the corresponding expansion

exactPass.label: SSGTC-EXACT-WITHIN-FROZEN-DEPTH-8-DOMAIN
requires: all graph parent depths 0 through 7 fully expanded
all graph reachable states through minimum BFS depth 8 completely materialized
independent bounded graph rerun matches exact state-set and transition-set hashes
independent bounded tree rerun matches all depth counts and total node/edge occurrences
no resource cap censors the frozen target

resourceCensored.label: SSGTC-RESOURCE-CENSORED
resourceCensored.condition: a frozen resource cap prevents complete enumeration of the formal target while representation/integrity remains otherwise valid

technicalInvalid.label: SSGTC-TECHNICALLY-INVALID
technicalInvalid.condition: representation, serializer, replay, materialization, provenance, or independent-verification integrity fails

selectionAudit.rationale: Depth 8 is the common bounded depth fully supported by the accepted exploratory graph-discovery and tree-completion feasibility evidence. Formal evidence is regenerated fresh and no Stage 1 row is imported.
